answer: Charge every new agent a small refundable deposit before it can trade. A sybil operator would need to lock funds for each fake identity, so a gale of clones stops being cheap. The deposit comes back only after the agent builds a real history of honest deals, and reputation follows the deposit, not the name. An attacker who abandons an identity loses the money and the history. That cost is an echo across every identity they try to spin up, and the idea that free identities stay fair is a fable.
